## Introduction 

This file assesses the reproducibility of the trial results by comparing all HTML-tables, the output database and imputed MMRM datasets in the current repo to a reference repo identified below. 

Knitting the file will expose any differences in results between the results produced by the current repo and the reference repo. If the parameter `params$stop_on_error` is `TRUE` processing the file (ie, running the script, aka. knitting the file) will exit the processing with an error. If `FALSE` any changes are simply exposed but no error is produced.

Value of `params$stop_on_error`: 
```{r}
params$stop_on_error
```


## Setup 

```{r setup, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(emmeans)    # required for output db checks
library(waldo)
library(rvest)
library(CRP)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")
```

Path to reference repo:
```{r}
ref_repo <- "L:/Auditdata/DEXA-PSYCH/15 - Databehandling/12 - GitHub Repository Dump/Versioned dumps/post-dbl-v1.0"
```

Define functions to print relevant differences from results of compare functions and optionally stop processing with an error:
```{r}
print_html_diffs <- function(diffs) {
  sum_diffs <- diffs$summary
  has_t_diffs <- sum_diffs[, which(table_diffs > 0)]
  has_f_diffs <- sum_diffs[, which(footer_diffs > 0)]
  has_diffs <- unique(c(has_t_diffs, has_f_diffs))
  if(length(has_diffs)) {
    message("Summary of differences:")
    print(sum_diffs[has_diffs])
    message("Table differences:")
    print(diffs$table_diffs[sum_diffs[has_t_diffs, file]])
    message("Table differences:")
    print(diffs$footer_diffs[sum_diffs[has_f_diffs, file]])
  }
  invisible(diffs)
}

print_rds_diffs <- function(diffs) {
  sum_diffs <- diffs$summary
  has_diffs <- sum_diffs[, which(n_diffs > 0)]
  if(length(has_diffs)) {
    message("Summary of differences:")
    print(sum_diffs[has_diffs])
    message("File differences:")
    print(diffs$diffs[sum_diffs[has_diffs, file]])
  }
  invisible(diffs)
}

stop_html_diffs <- function(diffs, stop_on_error = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(is.logical(stop_on_error) && length(stop_on_error) == 1L &&
              !is.na(stop_on_error))
  n_diffs <- diffs$summary[, sum(table_diffs > 0 | footer_diffs > 0, na.rm = TRUE)]
  if(stop_on_error && n_diffs > 0) 
    stop("Differences found in ", n_diffs, " files.")
  invisible(NULL)
}

stop_rds_diffs <- function(diffs, stop_on_error = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(is.logical(stop_on_error) && length(stop_on_error) == 1L &&
              !is.na(stop_on_error))
  n_diffs <- diffs$summary[, sum(n_diffs > 0, na.rm = TRUE)]
  if(stop_on_error && n_diffs > 0) 
    stop("Differences found in ", n_diffs, " files.")
  invisible(NULL)
}

```


## Check reproducibility of HTML outputs

Check all manual tables:
```{r html_manual_tables}
diffs <- compare_html_tables(reference_path = ref_repo,
                             new_path       = ".", 
                             folder         = "40_tlf_source/tables",
                             copy_files     = TRUE,
                             verbose        = TRUE)
print_html_diffs(diffs)
stop_html_diffs(diffs, stop_on_error = params$stop_on_error)
```

Check all auto-generated tables:
```{r html_auto_tables}
diffs <- compare_html_tables(reference_path = ref_repo,
                             new_path       = ".", 
                             folder         = "40_tlf_source/auto_tables",
                             copy_files     = TRUE,
                             verbose        = TRUE)
print_html_diffs(diffs)
stop_html_diffs(diffs, stop_on_error = params$stop_on_error)
```


## Check reproducibility of output database

Check output database stored as `data.table` objects in `rds` files:
```{r output_db}
diffs <- compare_rds_files(reference_path = ref_repo,
                           new_path       = ".",
                           folder         = "50_output_db/outputs",
                           tolerance      = 1e-6, 
                           copy_files     = TRUE, 
                           verbose        = TRUE)
print_rds_diffs(diffs)
stop_rds_diffs(diffs, stop_on_error = params$stop_on_error)
```

Repeat checks to report any differences regardless of tolerance:
```{r output_db_tol_NULL}
diffs <- compare_rds_files(reference_path = ref_repo,
                           new_path       = ".",
                           folder         = "50_output_db/outputs",
                           tolerance      = NULL, 
                           copy_files     = TRUE, 
                           verbose        = TRUE)
print_rds_diffs(diffs)
stop_rds_diffs(diffs, stop_on_error = FALSE)
```
